'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Pierre Dubreuil DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Pierre Dubreuil]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-D-astunningmove-pre.gif|label=A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage}}
* '''Username:''' BRINGHIMB4ME
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
